intro.quote: The Generalized Label Request supports communication of characteristics required to support the LSP being requested. These characteristics include LSP encoding and LSP payload.

fields.name: LSP Encoding Type
fields.explain: Identifies the encoding used by the data associated with the requested LSP.

cite.quote: LSP Encoding Type: 8 bits Indicates the encoding of the LSP being requested.

fields.name: Switching Type
fields.explain: Requests the type of switching to perform on a particular link.

cite.quote: Switching Type: 8 bits Indicates the type of switching that should be performed on a particular link. This field is needed for links that advertise more than one type of switching capability.

fields.name: Generalized PID (G-PID)
fields.explain: Identifies the payload carried by the LSP, or its client layer.

cite.quote: Generalized PID (G-PID): 16 bits An identifier of the payload carried by an LSP, i.e., an identifier of the client layer of that LSP.

intro.quote: The Label Set is used to limit the label choices of a downstream node to a set of acceptable labels. This limitation applies on a per hop basis.

fields.name: Action
fields.explain: Identifies how the Label Set treats its subchannel elements.

cite.quote: Action: 8 bits 0 - Inclusive List Indicates that the object/TLV contains one or more subchannel elements that are included in the Label Set.

fields.name: Reserved
fields.explain: This field is reserved and must be set to zero on transmission and ignored on receipt.

cite.quote: Reserved: 10 bits This field is reserved. It MUST be set to zero on transmission and MUST be ignored on receipt.

fields.name: Label Type
fields.explain: Indicates the type and format of the labels carried in the object or TLV.

cite.quote: Label Type: 14 bits Indicates the type and format of the labels carried in the object/TLV. Values are signaling protocol specific.

fields.name: Subchannel
fields.explain: Identifies an eligible label, such as a wavelength or fiber, using the generalized label format.

cite.quote: The subchannel represents the label (wavelength, fiber ... ) which is eligible for allocation. This field has the same format as described for labels under section 3.2.

intro.quote: Protection Information is carried in a new object/TLV. It is used to indicate link related protection attributes of a requested LSP. The use of Protection Information for a particular LSP is optional.

fields.name: Secondary (S)
fields.explain: When set, identifies the requested LSP as a secondary LSP.

cite.quote: Secondary (S): 1 bit When set, indicates that the requested LSP is a secondary LSP.

fields.name: Reserved
fields.explain: This field is reserved and must be set to zero on transmission and ignored on receipt.

cite.quote: Reserved: 25 bits This field is reserved. It MUST be set to zero on transmission and MUST be ignored on receipt. These bits SHOULD be pass through unmodified by transit nodes.

fields.name: Link Flags
fields.explain: Indicates the desired link protection type for the requested LSP.

cite.quote: Link Flags: 6 bits Indicates desired link protection type. As previously mentioned, protection capabilities of a link may be advertised in routing.
